name: Constellation Map
desc: A deep-sky star chart where twinkling stars are progressively laced together by constellation lines drawing themselves in, a faint mythic figure hinted behind the active sign and a rare shooting star streaking past.

density.doc: star count — higher fills a richer sky

energy.doc: twinkle amplitude + line glow + figure visibility

scale.doc: star/marker + line weight vs design size

lines.doc: constellation richness — number of signs woven

style.doc: render philosophy — glowing deep-sky / engraved antique ink / technical schematic / temperature false-color

act.doc: dramaturgy — lines lace in / whole sky wheels round the pole / frequent shooting stars
